_doc: Declarative backend role binding for OT DMA. irq declared explicitly: the auto-detector cannot resolve INTR_STATE here (dma's intr_state qs feed the read mux through the hw2reg d/de path shaped differently from the uart-class devices), offsets are the regtool ground truth (dma.hjson: INTR_STATE=0x0 INTR_ENABLE=0x4 INTR_TEST=0x8 ALERT_TEST=0xC, 3 interrupts: dma_done, dma_chunk_done, dma_error). bus_master comes in Phase 2. bus_master: the engine's OT-internal host port bridged to a QEMU AddressSpace (system memory until the SoC glue passes ot_address_space links); ctn/sys ports stay stubbed. pin_io data_in: the 11 hardware-handshake trigger lines (lsio_trigger_i) exported as qdev gpio-ins so the SoC can wire peripheral irq lines (via a splitter) into handshake mode.
